resources.string: Each sound plays at level\u00A020, 30 or 38, or not at all. The firmware sets the three levels; here you choose which sound gets which.
The bike has not reported its volumes yet. Until then, the ladders show the factory setting from firmware\u00A01.9.1.
The bike reports no volumes. Its firmware probably does not offer this value.
Please connect to the bike to read and save the volumes.
The bell button plays this sound. Set to silent, the button stays quiet.
Set to silent, the alarm still goes off, but without sound.
Set to silent, the search for the bike makes no sound.
Set to silent, the bike shows faults on the display only.
Every save rewrites the bike’s flash memory. YABA therefore writes only when you save.
Saving waits until the running transfer has finished.
Saved. The bike reports the new volumes back.
After saving, the bike reports a different setting. Please read the values from the bike again.
Five of the bike’s sounds can be replaced. YABA keeps every file it sends on this phone.
Probably silent: the last transfer broke off.
The bike does not give the factory sound back. Once sent over, it can only be restored with the factory file.
YABA converts audio files. A file already in the bike’s VM_SOUND format, such as a factory file, goes to the bike unchanged.
Please keep the phone close to the bike. If the transfer breaks off, the sound stays silent until a file arrives in full.
Possible once the bell tone has arrived; the bike accepts one transfer at a time.
“%1$s” is transferred. The bike plays it for “%2$s” from now on, even when YABA is not running.
The file could not be read. Please choose another audio file.
The file is larger than %1$d\u00A0kB, the most a bike sound can hold.
The file starts like a bike sound file but holds no WAV audio. Please choose another file.
YABA could not keep the file on this phone, so it does not send it. Please check the free storage.
The transfer broke off at %1$d%%. “%2$s” stays silent until a file arrives in full.
The transfer did not start. “%1$s” keeps its previous sound.
The bike does not give the factory sound for “%1$s” back, and YABA does not have it. Once sent over, it can only be restored with the factory file.
